item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.2

  • The close dot at the top of a note now works, and closing always works even when the note is pinned
  • A new note opens where you last left one, instead of snapping back to the screen edge
  • The pointer turns into a hand wherever the note's title bar can be dragged
  • Fixes "An error occurred while running the updater" when installing updates
